question: What is the first editor protocol boundary and which compiler services does it reuse?
decision: Add a stdio JSON-RPC/LSP prototype with initialize/shutdown/exit, full-document open/change/close synchronization, shared lexer/parser/type diagnostics, and whole-document formatting edits from the production formatter.

scope.documents: single in-memory document per URI; no workspace graph
scope.diagnostics: publish on open/change and clear on close

quantitative_gate: tests/lsp_tests.py is registered as the language_server CTest and inventory case; the broader M5B symbol/module query gate remains open.
